title: Keep releases optional
statement: As a developer, I can ignore releases entirely, so a team that only wants Reviews or Plans has nothing new to do.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Saga with no release records gets the same `status` and `check --covers health` results as it did before this feature.
Existing Sagas load without migration, and the first release is the only thing that adds release records.
The release that ships this records its new directory as a **Format** change and says readers must upgrade before adopting it.
